RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the December 16, 2004/Agrahayana 25, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy; Coal;
Communications and Information Technology; External Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Mines; Ocean Development; Overseas Indian Affairs; Personnel,
Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Science and Technology; Shipping,
Road Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions — 20
Drug research in India
*221. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) what steps his Ministry is taking or
propose to take to focus on drug research
in India;
(b) the money spent on drug research
during the last five years, year-wise;
(c) the money spent on drug research,
percentage-wise, out of profit earned by
companies during the last five years, year-
wise; and
(d) the measures Government are taking
to make India a leader in drug development?
Cellular phone service in the North
Eastern Region
†*222. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a)  the number of districts in the North
Eastern Region which are not having cellular
phone services;
(b) whether Government propose to
provide cellular phone services in such
districts; and
(c) if so, Government's policy in this
regard?
Central Inland Water Transport
Corporation
*223. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a proposal for revival of the Central Inland
Water Transport Corporation; and

(b) if so, the response of Government
thereto?
Subsidence in Eastern Coal Fields
Limited
*224. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there has been serious
subsidence in Sanctoria area of Eastern Coal
Fields Ltd.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the immediate measures taken, so
far to rehabilitate and compensate the
affected people; and
(d) the short term/long term measures
taken to prevent such subsidence?
Upgradation of highways in Bihar
†*225. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a)  the total length of National
Highways under National Highways
Development Project and Pradhan Mantri
Bharat Jodo Pariyojana respectively in
Bihar which are to be upgraded to four lane,
project-wise;
(b) the extent and the point from which
Patna is proposed to be connected and
joined through four lane National Highways
under Pradhan Mantri Bharat Jodo
Pariyojana; and
(c) the details of the progress of the
scheme?
Overbridge on NH-5
*226. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Road
Safety Forum had demanded a pedestrian
overbridge at Gundugolanu village on
National Highway No. 5;
(b) whether it is a fact that NHAI is
reluctant to receive and entertain
suggestions from road safety experts and
activists; and
(c) the steps proposed to correct this
situation immediately?
Budgetary allocation to States
*227. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Planning Commission
has decided to make additional budgetary
allocations for current fiscal year to the
States;
(b) if so, whether the Commission is
shuffling funds from one head to another
to help hard pressed States;
(c) if so, whether Centrally sponsored
schemes would be provided money from
State share of Rs. 10 crores additional funds
and State share may be squeezed;
(d) if so, the details of funds utilisation
by Planning Commission; and
(e) to what extent this has helped
deserving States to meet their financial
position?
† Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

68
Denial by Pakistan for an extradition
treaty
*228. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
of Pakistan has declined an Indian proposal
for an extradition treaty between the two
countries;
(b) if so, the specific reasons stated by
the Government of Pakistan in regard
thereto; and
(c) Government's reaction in this
regard?
Safety of labour
*229. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are executing
any programme to create awareness of the
safety of labour at their work place;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the segments identified and funds
allocated for the purpose to Tamil Nadu?
Creation of job opportunities

SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:

Donation for ARIs
1435. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have closed
the donation for the Agro industries;
(b) whether the funds released by
Government are not enough to run these
industries; and
(c) if so, the details about the Agro
industries and the release of funds in the
year 2003-04?
PMRY in Maharashtra
1436. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
reviewed performance of on-going projects
under the Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Yojana in
Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether his Ministry have set any
target for generating more employment
opportunities in Maharashtra State under
this scheme; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Preservation of fruits and
vegetables
†1437. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Bhabha
Atomic Research Centre has developed a
technique of long lasting preservation of
fruits, vegetables and cereals; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

316
Threat on National Security due to
mining of mineral sands
1438. SHRI N. K. PREMACHAND-
RAN: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any project is pending with
Government to obtain permission for
mining of mineral sands from the coastal
areas of Kollam or from Alappuzha
districts of Kerala State by any private or
joint venture firms;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government see any threat
on the National Security to allow mining of
mineral sands containing rare earths by
private companies; and
(d) if so, Government’s reaction
thereto?
Storage of radioactive wastes
1439. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that management
and disposal of long-life radioactive wastes
has been a technical and political problem
world-over;
(b) whether it is also a fact that M/s
Reliance Industries Ltd., have released a
comprehensive report to redress this issue;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof especially
those relating to short-term and viable long-
term solution for waste storage?
Private participation in Atomic Energy
production
1440. SHRI K. B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether  the amended Atomic
Energy Act waiting for the approval of the
Parliament provides  for private
participation in nuclear energy production
in the country;
(b) whether according to the amended
provision, the Department of Atomic
Energy and the Nuclear Power Corporation
of  India Limited will be bound to provide
technical support to the private power
producer; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Appointment of UDCs
1441. SHRI VIDYA SAGAR
NISHAD: Will the Minister of ATOMIC
ENERGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that examination
for the post of UDC were held in the month
of June, 2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that even
after a lapse of about three years of
examination, selected candidates have not
been called to join ;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) by when, the selected candidates
would be called to join?
Setting up of  desalination plant at
Chennai
1442.  SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the PRIME
MINISTER  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Bhabha  Atomic
Research Centre has worked on
desalination technologies and has
experience in erecting large-scale
desalination plants;
(b) if so, the details of plants erected
by them to help drinking water problem;
and

317
(c) whether they would participate in
the proposed desalination plants to be set
up in Chennai that would produce 300
million litres of potable water a day?
Royalties on coal
1443. SHRI PY ARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: Will the Minister of
COAL  be pleased to state:
(a) considering that the ratio between
royalties for higher and inferior rates in coals
as in the year 1971 has progressively
declined against the inferior varieties to
successive revision of royalty whether
Government propose to consider
restoration of the earlier ratio of 1971;
and
(b) if so, within what time-frame  and if
not, the reasons therefor?
